preconditions.description: Length of str1 is between 1 and 100.
Length of str2 is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '*#@' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: Each character in str1 is one of '*', '#', or '@'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '*#@' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: Each character in str2 is one of '*', '#', or '@'.

postconditions.description: The number of bridges is between 0 and the minimum length of str1 and str2.
The number of bridges is the maximum possible number of bridges that can be built.
